completionSentence: 사용자가 파일 이름과 위치를 정확히 기억하지 못해도, T5는 사용자가 지정한 컴퓨터·작업공간·폴더 범위에서 이름·위치·내용 단서로 실제 후보를 찾고 선택한 파일만 다시 열며, 중복과 버전 근거를 최종본 판단과 분리한다.
qualified: The file capability is deferred and adds no schema to the default model context before tool_search selects it.
Computer, workspace and exact-path scopes are explicit; injected index results outside the selected roots and protected credential roots are excluded.
Search returns bounded metadata and opaque handles without raw file content; exact inspect revalidates file identity before content is opened.
Text probes use bounded byte reads rather than loading an entire large file into memory.
Exact byte duplicates, filename similarity, bounded text similarity, size delta and modification time remain separate evidence; the runtime does not declare a final version.
A changed file invalidates its prior handle instead of reopening stale content.
The filesystem walk is bounded by files and wall time and reports roots, visited entries, unreadable directories, content probes and truncation.
notClaimed: Perfect semantic recall for every file type and every vague clue
Durable whole-computer content indexing owned by T5
Past Work and Conversation evidence merged into the same ranking
Automatic final-version selection, deletion, moving, renaming or organization
Physical Windows Search qualification or enumeration of every Windows volume
Completion of the broader general-affairs file intelligence development line
